title: What all is going on right now

history.content: What all is going on right now

Okay, right now there's an active task to refine the plan for modifying the `get_weather` tool. Recent attempts to modify the `get_weather` tool and `learn_fact` tool have failed due to issues with code generation and an unknown tool modification failure. The system also had trouble getting the original code for `ai_assistant.custom_tools.generated.get_weather`. Recently modified files include `div_table_generator.py`, `weather_tool.py`, `generate_safe_html.py`, `location_utils.py`, and `ai_response_generator.py`.
